verdict.rationale: uv documents support for macOS, Linux, and Windows, and its project workflow uses the same files everywhere: `uv.lock` is explicitly a cross-platform lockfile, alongside `pyproject.toml` and `.python-version` pins. A community user confirms it solved environment consistency for mixed macOS/Linux teams. The early lack of a platform-agnostic lockfile reported at launch is superseded by the current cross-platform `uv.lock` docs. missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of the workflow on Windows specifically, explicit documentation that uv settings and config files behave identically across all three OSes.
